name: GitHub MCP Server
shortDescription: Inspect repositories, search code, manage issues, pull requests, commits and branch management directly from AI assistants.
longDescription: The official GitHub Model Context Protocol server enables your AI assistant to read, search, and manipulate repositories, branches, files, pull requests, issues, and commits through GitHub's GraphQL and REST APIs.
author: modelcontextprotocol

envVars.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained) with repo permissions.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file in a repository with commit message.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search for GitHub repositories using query parameters.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a specified repository.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request between branches.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Retrieve file contents or directory listing from repository branch.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Fetch commit history for a branch or file.

prerequisites: A GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) with repo and user scopes

installSteps.title: Generate GitHub Token
installSteps.description: Visit GitHub Settings > Developer Settings > Personal access tokens and generate a token with repo read/write scopes.

installSteps.title: Restart AI Assistant
installSteps.description: Restart Claude Desktop, Cursor, or your assistant to initialize connection to the GitHub MCP server.

examples.title: Inspect Recent Pull Requests
examples.prompt: Show me all open PRs in my repository username/project and summarize their diffs.

examples.title: Create a Bug Issue
examples.prompt: File an issue in username/repo titled 'Fix CORS header missing' with steps to reproduce.
